reviews.author: Dihia Chebini
reviews.text:
I had such a lovely experience at this salon! 💕 The African girl who did my nails was absolutely amazing — so sweet, kind, and professional. She paid so much attention to every little detail and did her work with great care and precision. I’m honestly so happy with the results and absolutely love my nails! 😍✨

The whole team was also very friendly, welcoming, and lovely. You can really feel the positive atmosphere and care they put into their work. Special thanks to the lovely girl who did my nails — she did an outstanding job! I’ll definitely be coming back. Highly recommend! ❤️💅

reviews.author: Fatima Tan
reviews.text:
I had the most amazing HydraFacial.My aesthetician was incredibly knowledgeable and explained every single step of the process. The extraction process was painless, and the hydrating serums left my face feeling plump and refreshed. An hour of pure luxury, and I walked out with my skin glowing! Highly recommend this place.
And I also  had my full makeup and hair done here, and I am absolutely in love with the result! The makeup artist listened perfectly to what I wanted and made sure my skin looked flawless, glowy, and natural. Highly recommend!"
